title: Eight Essential Field Skills (Offline)
summary: Eight independently selectable, human-reviewed field-skill source slots. First-party CodeBound guide cards are available separately; this pack contains no third-party files until explicitly imported and bound.

slots.title: Responsible hunting, fishing and wild-food safety
slots.subject: food
slots.source: CodeBound field-hunt-fish-harvest; EPA fish advisories; current local fish-and-game regulations; licensed and reviewed field manuals

slots.title: Emergency water sourcing and microbial treatment
slots.subject: water
slots.source: CodeBound field-purify-water; current CDC water emergency guidance

slots.title: Evidence-first first aid and plant-remedy safety
slots.subject: health
slots.source: CodeBound field-natural-medicine-literacy; IFRC first aid and NIH NCCIH safety resources; professionally reviewed only

slots.title: Safe temporary shelter and exposure protection
slots.subject: survival
slots.source: CodeBound field-build-shelter; NPS Ten Essentials and current local hazards

slots.title: Seasonal gardening, seed saving and soil health
slots.subject: agriculture
slots.source: CodeBound field-grow-garden; local cooperative extension service

slots.title: Safe portable power, loads, batteries and solar
slots.subject: energy
slots.source: CodeBound field-create-power; FEMA and manufacturer-approved electrical safety guidance

slots.title: Nonviolent self-protection, avoidance and safe escape
slots.subject: survival
slots.source: CodeBound field-personal-safety; de-escalation and household safety training; exclude weapons instructions

slots.title: Map and compass navigation with offline route planning
slots.subject: maps
slots.source: CodeBound field-navigate; NPS / USGS map-and-compass references

note: Never interpret missing slots as ready; source list is a discovery queue, not downloaded data or advice approval. A source's license, edition and safety must be reviewed separately before real-world use or redistribution.
